definitions.explanation: A flat piece of wood or other material.
A flat piece of metal or other material.

examples.english: To sit on the wooden floor.

examples.japanese: {板|いた}{挟|ばさ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: To be caught between two sides.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{板|いた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}られている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: It is made from a thin metal sheet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{銅|どう}→銅：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{板|いた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{刻|きざ}まれていた→刻む：03918_kizamu⟧。
examples.english: Letters were engraved on a copper plate.

notes:
{板|いた} refers to flat pieces of material.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {看板|かんばん}: signboard
- {黒板|こくばん}: blackboard
- {まな{板|いた}}: cutting board
- {板|いた}の{間|ま}: wooden floor
- {板|いた}チョコ: chocolate bar

IDIOMS:
- {板|いた}{挟|ばさ}み: caught between two parties
- {板|いた}に{付|つ}く: to become skilled at
